description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Riven''' can activate ''Broken Wings'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 0.3125-second static cooldown between casts. If '''Riven''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
description.text: Active: Riven can activate Broken Wings three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 0.3125-second static cooldown between casts. If Riven does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.

description2.raw: '''Riven''' slashes with her sword for each of the three casts, dealing physical damage to enemies struck within an area, [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resetting]] her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of ''Broken Wings'' if there are any.
description2.text: Riven slashes with her sword for each of the three casts, dealing physical damage to enemies struck within an area, resetting her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of Broken Wings if there are any.

description3.raw: '''First Cast:''' '''Riven''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.
description3.text: First Cast: Riven dashes 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.

description4.raw: '''Second Cast:''' '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects.
description4.text: Second Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects.

description5.raw: '''Third Cast:''' '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking back]] enemies hit 75 units over 0.5 seconds. This cast can cross terrain.
description5.text: Third Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also knocking back enemies hit 75 units over 0.5 seconds. This cast can cross terrain.

notes.raw: * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. * Each cast counts as a single ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * Moving after using ''Broken Wings'' allows Riven to do other actions faster. * The '''Third Cast''' prevents '''Riven''' from using basic attacks and abilities for longer than the other 2 casts. * The '''Third Cast''' may have an extended dash range when crossing terrain. * The '''Third Cast's''' [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knockup]] debuff is not removed early if the forced movement is interrupted. * Any forced movement affecting the target being knocked up is [[File:Knockdown icon.png|20px|link=Knockdown|An icon representing the keyword Knockdown]] [[:Knockdown|interrupted]] when the [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knockup]] debuff is removed.(unexpected)
notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Each cast counts as a single ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Moving after using Broken Wings allows Riven to do other actions faster.
The Third Cast prevents Riven from using basic attacks and abilities for longer than the other 2 casts.
The Third Cast may have an extended dash range when crossing terrain.
The Third Cast's knockup debuff is not removed early if the forced movement is interrupted.
Any forced movement affecting the target being knocked up is interrupted when the knockup debuff is removed.(unexpected)
